name: Santa Eulària Ibiza 12K

trackSource.notes: GPX "Eivissa 12K 2026" linked as "Download track GPX" on the 12K page on 2026-11-27. It is labelled 2026 (an earlier track): it measures 12.251 km against 12.235 km for the carried route, and the existing points fit it. The KMZ linked next to it (line "12K IBIZA MARATHON") names no year.

notes: On 2026-11-27 the 12K regulations page (https://ibizamarathon.es/en/12k-regulations/) named the 2027 edition and gave a provisional 4:00 p.m. start in a sentence without the year, while the 12K page said "Time: Soon.", so the start time was left unknown.
